proof_body:
by
  intro f g a K r hr hf hg ε hε
  have hK : 0 < |K| + 1 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hg (ε / (|K| + 1)) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨min r δ, lt_min hr hδ, fun x h0 hx => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hf x h0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (min_le_left _ _))
  have h2 := h x h0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hx (min_le_right _ _))
  have h3 : |f x| ≤ |K| + 1 := by linarith [le_abs_self K]
  rw [abs_mul]
  calc |f x| * |g x| ≤ (|K| + 1) * |g x| := by gcongr
    _ < (|K| + 1) * (ε / (|K| + 1)) := by gcongr
    _ = ε := by field_simp
